plan: Drive: from District of Stewart, about 67 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.93602, -129.22351, pull off on Meziadin FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.6 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 319 m, about 145 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 100 m E of the spot at 309 m (55.90261, -129.29055). Water: unnamed wetland 70 m W (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-16, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.
R6L-duck-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-16: about 107 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
